pr_title: Add a fallback for non-embedded *composite* Verdana fonts (issue 11242)
pr_body:
Obviously this won't look exactly right, but considering that the PDF file doesn't bother embedding non-standard fonts this is the best that we can do here.

Fixes #11242

issue_context.title: PDF fonts not displaying correctly
issue_context.body:
Attach (recommended) or Link to PDF file here:
[Font Issues - Example PDF.pdf](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/files/3728976/Font.Issues.-.Example.PDF.pdf)

Configuration:
- Web browser and its version: Firefox Quantum (69.0.3 (64-bit))
- Operating system and its version: Windows 8.1 Pro
- PDF.js version: Not sure (latest Firefox browser build as above)
- Is a browser extension: Not sure

Steps to reproduce the problem:
1. Open the attached file (Font Issues - Example PDF.pdf) in Chrome or Adobe or any other PDF viewer and the fonts display correctly.
2. Open the same PDF in Firefox and all the fonts display incorrectly.

What is the expected behavior? (add screenshot)
![PDF displayed correctly in Acrobat](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/56589547/66827967-d06c8480-ef47-11e9-9bce-498996e02f5a.JPG)


What went wrong? (add screenshot)
All fonts being rendered and displayed incorrectly.
![Screenshot when viewed in Firefox](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/56589547/66828061-07db3100-ef48-11e9-8f22-2416f3e17301.JPG)



Link to a viewer (if hosted on a site other than mozilla.github.io/pdf.js or as Firefox/Chrome extension):

review_comments: I can't help but wonder why we need the plus character here and in other parts of this patch. As far as I can tell from https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/de56518799b869d1cb4d313c7628a8aa956966f8/src/core/standard_fonts.js#L269 and other code, character codes should already be numeric. Is that true or am I missing something here?
When using the `for (key in object)` format the `key` ends up being converted to a string, which is something you don't want when indexing an Array.
Ah, that's it. Makes sense; thanks!
